country_policy_primary_evidence.observed: Enforcement includes unsafe models and datasets in poorly managed open-source communities; no per-model scheduled deletion.
Export proposal and public-technology exclusions/fast-track, not announced global model weight ban.
GPAI provider requirements and conditional open-source exceptions; systemic-risk models have additional obligations.
Prior government model access is voluntary; no authority to create mandatory preclearance in specified section.
Platform content policy permits gating, unranking, disabling or removal after review.
Gated permissions are granted by individual model authors and can be revoked; metadata visibility does not mean weight access.

As of 2026-11-15 official implementation timeline lists 2026-12-02 transition for non-consensual sexual deepfake/CSAM-generation prohibitions and other transparency rules; system/use prohibition does not itself ban all open weights.
Open-source exemptions require free licence and publicly available weights/architecture/usage; systemic-risk providers are not exempt.

model_scope_decisions.reason: Distinct full-duplex audio-to-audio learned codec integrated; no additional VibeVoice payload dependency; full owner license/runtime check pending
Distinct 27.2B total MoE video+action DROID checkpoint, 17 shards; Qwen3.5-2B and shared Wan VAE are dependencies not duplicate portfolio assets
Pinned NVIDIA implementation contains relational graph message passing, unlike single-table Kumo-Tabular; publication of 29.93M–30.94M component counts does not substitute payload tensor count

HF currently tags CC BY-NC 4.0 and quantized parent ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-GGUF; independently trained new weights and incremental quality are unproven. Third-party historical license-change trackers need source revision verification.
Overlaps two active OCR models; no matched gain or unique trained mechanism sufficient to justify the optional extra 2.5GB and custom-code ABI
Hub 321B total parameters, quantized peak RAM under same hardware/backend/context/batch vs <150B reference not measured; active experts are not total.
